label: Linear perspective
text: AR.O.A2.1.5 Linear perspective. A central projection onto a plane. It assumes one fixed eye, a planar picture surface and straight light paths. Under these, parallel lines not parallel to the plane meet at a vanishing point. The projective geometry uses MA; the pictorial system is here. Brunelleschi (c. 1415–20) and Alberti, *De pictura* (1435).
